gearbalance.config.title: GearBalance Settings
gearbalance.config.all_vanilla.tip: Removes all changes and level requirements. Saved profiles are kept.
gearbalance.config.note: Green = saved, yellow = not saved yet. Applies after a restart.
gearbalance.stat.durability.tip: How many uses the item lasts (1 to 10000).
gearbalance.stat.damage.tip: Total damage, as shown in the item tooltip.
gearbalance.stat.speed.tip: Attacks per second as shown in the tooltip (sword 1.6, axe 0.8 to 1.0).
gearbalance.stat.mining.tip: Added to the mining speed, similar to Efficiency. 0 = vanilla.
gearbalance.stat.armor.tip: Armor points (half an armor icon per point, 30 at most).
gearbalance.stat.toughness.tip: Armor toughness. Helps against strong hits (diamond 2, netherite 3).
gearbalance.stat.knockback.tip: 0 to 1. Netherite has 0.1 per piece (1 = no knockback).
gearbalance.stat.shield_disable.tip: Seconds the shield can't be used after an axe hit. 0 = never disabled. Shield only.
gearbalance.stat.shield_block.tip: How many percent of the damage from the front the shield blocks. 100 = vanilla. Shield only.
gearbalance.options.title: GearBalance Options
gearbalance.options.enabled.tip: Off: every item has its vanilla values again. Your changes stay saved. Applies after a restart.
gearbalance.options.set_bonuses.tip: Bonus for wearing 2 and 4 armor pieces of the same material. Set up in the "Set bonuses" tab. Applies at once.
gearbalance.options.trident.tip: Prismarine crystals, a nautilus shell and sticks make a trident. Applies after /reload.
gearbalance.options.chainmail.tip: Craft chainmail armor from iron chains. Applies after /reload.
gearbalance.profiles.title: Profiles
gearbalance.profiles.name: Profile name
gearbalance.profiles.save.tip: Saves all current settings in this profile: values, materials, set bonuses and switches like loot, anvil and recipes. Overwrites the profile.
gearbalance.profiles.load.tip: Replaces the current values with this profile.
gearbalance.export.tip: Saves the current settings as a file in config/gearbalance/profiles/. You can share the file or put it into a modpack.
gearbalance.import.tip: Loads a file from config/gearbalance/profiles/. Just drop files from others into that folder.
gearbalance.import.title: Import settings
gearbalance.import.failed: The file could not be read, nothing was changed.
gearbalance.profiles.save.confirm.title: Overwrite "%s"?
gearbalance.profiles.save.confirm.messag: The profile is replaced by the current settings. What was saved in it before is lost.
gearbalance.profiles.clear.confirm.title: Clear "%s"?
gearbalance.profiles.clear.confirm.messa: All settings in this profile are deleted. This can't be undone.
gearbalance.import.file.tip: Click to load. Replaces the current settings, you'll be asked first.
gearbalance.import.delete.confirm.title: Delete "%s"?
gearbalance.import.delete.confirm.messag: The file is deleted for good. This can't be undone.
gearbalance.import.delete.failed: The file could not be deleted.
gearbalance.preset.balanced.tip: Vanilla without its weak spots: gold lasts much longer, leather twice as long, netherite gets more durability, damage and toughness. Plus trident and chainmail recipes, no "Too Expensive!", zombie leather and better endgame loot. No level requirements.
gearbalance.preset.progression.short: Every tier has to be earned
gearbalance.preset.progression.tip: Like VanillaPlus, plus level requirements (copper 5 up to netherite 35), armor weight (iron the heaviest, netherite the lightest) and set bonuses for every material.
gearbalance.preset.challenge.tip: A quarter less durability, anvil repairs only 15 %, level requirements up to 50, more weight, weaker set bonuses and a shield that blocks only 80 %.
gearbalance.load.confirm.title: Load "%s"?
gearbalance.load.confirm.message: Your current settings are replaced. Anything you haven't saved in a profile of your own is lost. The values apply after a restart.
gearbalance.restart.title: Restart needed
gearbalance.restart.message: The new values only apply after restarting Minecraft. Quit the game now? Your world will be saved, then simply start Minecraft again.
gearbalance.tab.materials.tip: Values per material: required level, anvil repair and armor weight.
gearbalance.config.column.level.tip: Experience level that must have been reached at least once. Until then armor can't be worn, tools mine like the bare hand and weapons deal no damage. Spending levels or dying does not lock anything again. Creative mode is not affected. 0 = no requirement.
gearbalance.config.column.repair.tip: How many percent of the durability one repair item restores at the anvil, for example an ingot or a diamond. 25 = vanilla.
gearbalance.config.column.weight.tip: How many percent slower the full set makes you (0 to 90, in steps of 0.1). Each worn piece counts a quarter. Leather has no weight. 0 = vanilla.
gearbalance.tab.sets.tip: Bonus per armor material: half from 2 pieces, full with 4 pieces.
gearbalance.config.column.bonus.tip: What the set bonus does. Click to change.
gearbalance.config.column.strength.tip: Bonus with 4 pieces. With 2 or 3 pieces you get half. 0 = off.
gearbalance.config.column.strength.hint: Strength with 4 pieces, half with 2 pieces.
gearbalance.config.note_sets_off: Set bonuses are switched off in the options.
gearbalance.set.title: %s set (%s/4)
gearbalance.bonus.reach.tip: Extra blocks of reach for mining and attacking.
gearbalance.bonus.oxygen.tip: Breathe longer under water, like Respiration.
gearbalance.bonus.burning.tip: Percent shorter burning after catching fire.
gearbalance.bonus.luck.tip: Better loot from fishing and chests.
gearbalance.config.note_materials: Level and repair apply at once, weight after a restart.
gearbalance.options.rabbit_recipe.tip: 1 leather makes 4 rabbit hides. Applies after /reload.
gearbalance.options.rabbit_armor.tip: Leather armor is crafted from rabbit hides instead of leather (same pattern). Applies after /reload.
gearbalance.options.anvil.tip: On: the anvil never says "Too Expensive!". Costs above the cap on the right are lowered to it. Applies at once.
gearbalance.options.anvil_max.tip: Highest cost in levels (1 to %s). Default: 39.
gearbalance.options.zombie_leather.tip: Zombies, husks, drowned and zombie villagers can drop 1 leather when they die. Applies at once.
gearbalance.options.zombie_leather_chanc: Chance of leather in percent (1 to %s). Default: 33.
gearbalance.options.loot.tip: Zombie leather and the chests in end cities, bastions, ancient cities and trial chamber vaults.
gearbalance.loot.title: GearBalance Loot
gearbalance.options.loot_templates.tip: Extra chance for templates: netherite upgrade and snout in bastions, spire in end cities, ward and silence in ancient cities, bolt and flow in vaults. Applies at once.
gearbalance.options.loot_materials.tip: One or two extra valuable items per endgame chest, fitting the place: gold and netherite in bastions, gold, emeralds, shulker shells and potions in the End, echo shards and amethyst in ancient cities. Applies at once.
gearbalance.options.loot_no_cheap.tip: Swaps filler like bones, string, coal, arrows, bread, chains and nuggets in endgame chests for valuable loot that fits the place. In the End, iron is swapped too, among other things for potions of slow falling, healing, regeneration and strength. Books are left alone. Trial chamber supply chests stay as they are. Applies at once.
gearbalance.reset.title: Reset everything to vanilla?
gearbalance.reset.message: All changed values and level requirements are removed. Saved profiles are kept.
gearbalance.welcome.title: GearBalance is free
